steps.line: Layla. Awake. Good. Didn't die on the drop. Sit up. Tell me what's on the board.
Handler. Floor one. Cold, damp, stone. Look around.

The dark gives way in pieces. Cold stone under your palm. The smell of old smoke and damp fur. A shape standing beside you — a made thing of rough stone, flat-eyed, watching like a closed door. Your name is Layla; past that, a blank wall. In your pocket, faintly warm, a stub of chalk. Your hands remember what your memory lost: how to grip, how to move, how to take a hit. Find a way through.
The chalk in your pocket. Warm. Draw a closed ring around marked stone units. Ring closes, it follows you. Mind the rules in the floor. Reach the bottom.
